replacement.description: The new URL, fetched and verified, without a #fragment. Empty when there is none.

fragments.description: For replace and update-guidance: each section from the prompt, mapped to the new page's anchor.

from.description: A section from the prompt, without the #.

to.description: The matching anchor on the new page, without the #, or empty.

evidence.description: The replacement's page title, the redirect, or what loaded.

guidance.description: For update-guidance: what changed and the smallest true edit.

skipPattern.description: For skip-pattern: the anchored regex. Empty otherwise.

attempts.description: The status of each fetch attempt.
